title: Orthodontics
html:
Orthodontics impacts your child’s health, appearance, and more.

Crooked, unevenly spaced, or misaligned teeth are harder to keep clean. This makes them more prone to tooth decay and periodontal disease. Straight, properly aligned teeth are easier to keep clean and provide a more attractive appearance. A straight, healthy smile helps to boost self-esteem, self-confidence, and your child’s self-image. If your child suffers from crooked, uneven, or misaligned teeth, orthodontic treatment can help. The length of your orthodontic treatment will depend on their individual plan. During the consultation with Dr. William Sung, we will discuss their options. Once you select your child’s treatment, we will estimate its length. There are factors that can affect the duration of the treatment. Some of these include:
  • Early Orthodontic Intervention: If your child has had early intervention, some steps have already been completed. This may shorten the time needed for this treatment.
  • Type of Treatment: Depending on your child’s needs, they may have braces, elastics, aligners, or other options. The type of treatment they receive will affect its length.
  • Compliance: Following our instructions will allow your child’s treatment to work more quickly.
At Mason Park Dental, we offer advanced solutions for treatment. Depending on your child’s needs, we may recommend:
  • Early intervention
  • Invisalign®
  • Retainers
To get started on creating a healthier, more beautiful smile for your child, contact our office for a consultation.
